title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending

meta.Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Line: Morning
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rise and shine!
It's another fun and exciting morni-morni-morning!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder what's for breakfast♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Ah, Emu, you're awake.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You're up earlier than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
We've got practice this morning, so I wanna head out as soon as... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What are you guys doing?
The table's all covered in papers...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Ah, these are the attendance figures for last month, as well as the results of our customer satisfaction survey.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: They just came in yesterday, so we've been going over them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Attendance figures, and a survey...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can I look too?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna know how many visitors the park got, and how happy it made them... Can I see?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Then, why don't you start with these figures...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...?
So many numbers...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: To be fair, it's hard to figure anything out just at a glance.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: These are last month's attendance figures. This section separates our guests by age and gender. And if you compare these numbers to the previous month...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Wow! They went up a whole lot!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's clear that the 30th Anniversary Show ended up becoming a big hit.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It was also good how we advertised that the ever-popular Phoenix Stage would be doing a show with Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
And you all did an astounding job.
As a result, the Phoenix Stage has seen a new influx of fans.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Speaking of which, we also got the survey results for the 30th Anniversary Show.
We were planning to send them over to everyone involved later, but... Would you rather look now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna see!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: (The Phoenix Stage is our chief moneymaker, but the Wonder Stage just keeps getting more and more popular...)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: (Truth be told, Emu and the rest of Wonderlands×Showtime really delivered for us again.)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (As the operators of this park, we need them to stay as long as possible.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see...
“'The Happy Phoenix' was great!
I hope we get to see another showing of it someday!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna do it again too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now, what did this next person say...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “My heart ached so much when I saw how conflicted Rio was between wanting to save his mother and not wanting to sacrifice his friend, the phoenix!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “It was amazing how the Cowardly Canary sang with everything she had despite being so scared. She inspired me to also do my best even when I'm afraid.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...! That's so great...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Nene both worked really, really hard on their roles.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm really glad to see that their performances made everyone smile!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're both much sparklier compared to before. I bet they're going to keep sparkling more and more.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And go out into the world...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I might have to say goodbye to them soon...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That really does make me sad...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Emu... You don't have to make yourself smile if something is making you feel sad!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What Len said was so thoughtful...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we probably will have to go our separate ways in order to pursue our dreams...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thought of that happening is really sad and makes my heart sink...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But when that happens...
I have a feeling that it'll be the moment when we take a big step towards achieving our goals...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, when that happens... I'd like it if we could all smile and laugh in support of one another...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want to give them a proper goodbye with a smile...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want to be able to say, “I'm really happy for you guys! Good luck!”)
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah...! “My eyes began welling up during that scene when Rio cried.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
They empathized with Rio just that much! I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “The Cowardly Canary put on such a wonderful performance. I started to think that she was a real bird partway through. I couldn't believe what I was seeing.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It really is nice to hear back from the audience like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
This show was really worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and I believe that's the last of the surveys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing these with you, Emu! The motivation we gained today will serve us well tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe! I know, right?!
I'm really glad they let me borrow these!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, the 30th Anniversary Show truly proved a great experience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, if we hadn't done this show, I probably never would've realized that my singing was missing something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand now that I need to keep learning and experiencing new things if I want to improve as an actress...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
You both grew quite a bit through this show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You two sparkled like crazy before, but you were really dazzling this time around!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like a super duper sparkle nova!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That sounds like a character's finishing move...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, what you said about experiencing new things... That's a tricky one...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu's brothers kindly extended us an opportunity this time, but we probably won't be receiving them frequently...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, they did this for us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's right...!
We were so busy that I didn't get a chance to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After our last ambassadorial performance, I actually went to ask them if we could somehow keep putting on more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! You did?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Unfortunately, they said it wouldn't be possible...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But I think they asked us to be in the 30th Anniversary Show because of what I said.
I'll need to thank them again the next time I get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I didn't know he went to talk to them...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That must be just how much he wants to keep learning and performing in different places...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, you have a point...
I doubt they can keep serving up stuff for us on silver platters.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means we have to start thinking about what we can do ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
We can start by seeing if we can do more with our shows at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What else is there...?
We could each start attending short workshops on our own time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But long-term workshops and collaborations with other troupes will prove a challenge. They'll likely conflict with our own shows...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If only we could...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's try putting our heads together! We might figure something out that way!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You said it before yourself, Tsukasa.
“We can overcome anything as long as we work together! That's what Wonderlands×Showtime is all about!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for that, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I was thinking we could discuss that now, but...
We need to start on our basic training for the day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. We mustn't deviate from our daily regimen! We can discuss this matter another day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When the time comes for them to say that they wish to leave the Wonder Stage, will you try to follow in their footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because my dream is to protect Grandpa's amusement park and keep it the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And make a place where everyone smiles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Emu's mind is already made up...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (While...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm having trouble letting go.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone...
Would you mind if I said something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies, but I'll have to leave practice early today. I have an appointment after this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You do? That's fine, but... You made an appointment?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A very important appointment.
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to meet with me today. I know you're both very busy people.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You don't need to be so formal with us.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yeah, have a seat. I'll ask someone to bring us some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, that won't be necessary.
I plan on leaving before Emu returns.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, let's get down to business.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What is this “important matter” you wished to discuss with us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to discuss what we'll be doing as a troupe moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Would you mind elaborating...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To cut to the chase...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I would like Wonderlands×Showtime to become a freelance troupe that operates independent of the park.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Freelance...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Care to explain further...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, as I'm sure you're both keenly aware, Tsukasa and Nene are absolutely aching to keep growing as actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And in order to do that, they feel that they'll need to go out into the world and experience many new things.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to support them in their endeavors...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe they should be allowed to spread their wings, work with other actors, troupes, groups and companies...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Simultaneously...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like the four of us to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My hope is that we can pursue our dreams together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like the opportunity to separate ourselves from the park and become a freelance troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also understand that us leaving so suddenly would cause quite a few problems for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've been fortunate enough to gain a sizable fan base through the night shows and our ambassadorial performances.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, you have...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The numbers for anything show-related have only been going up. And your troupe's role in that has not been small.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: If possible, we'd like for you all to stay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't wish to cause you or the park any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm proposing a solution that benefits both us and Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a freelance troupe, we could agree to a deal that allows us to keep performing shows on a semi-regular basis at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That would certainly help us quite a lot, since we wouldn't have to immediately part ways with Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As the park's operators, we can't immediately get on board with your proposal.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: First, once you leave the park, you'll be putting on fewer shows there. That puts us in a tough position.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
And there are other issues to consider.
We'd be giving you special treatment, which the other cast members may not like.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Worst case scenario, others will see what you're doing as a sign to also go independent. Operating the park would become incredibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: With those considerations in mind, we can't give just your troupe special treatment...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: There's also a point we need to set straight.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You said you'd like “the four of you” to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: So, you're including Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm here not only to ask you both about us becoming freelancers, but also to discuss this matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind allowing me to invite Emu along?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (I had a feeling this would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Do you understand what you're saying...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You're essentially trying to take away a member of the Otori family.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I know I'm asking a lot...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I feel that I need to ask Emu to come with us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just once. Please, give me a chance to invite her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's our dear friend...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This is ultimately her decision to make.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I just mentioned, you becoming freelancers poses many problems for us.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, we're also not in a position to force you to stay on your current contracts.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
We'll consider your proposal...
Let us hope that it works out for both parties in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Practice should be ending soon.
Emu's going to be home in not too long...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'll take my leave here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Again, thank you both for taking the time out of your busy schedules to meet with me.
The next day
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm at the main gate!
Okay, good...! I should make it in time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still, Rui said he wanted to talk to all of us... What could this be about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, I have to hurry...!
I'm gonna be late if I keep stopping to think!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, there you are...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry I couldn't come sooner!
So, what do you wanna talk to us about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're all here now, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it you want to talk about that's putting such a serious look on your face? Mind telling us what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, let's all take a seat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is going to take quite a bit of time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Going freelance...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If we went independent, we could perform elsewhere while also continuing to do shows at the Wonder Stage...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well done, Rui!
I didn't know you'd come up with such an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I can't ignore the fact that you went to discuss this with Emu's brothers on your own. You should've been more forthcoming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Look who's talking...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize for keeping that from all of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I didn't want to raise your hopes before actually seeing if this would be possible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That makes sense...
Well, it's great that they agreed to consider your idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Of course, gaining their full approval won't be easy since this idea directly affects the park's profitability...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time, based on what I could sense from them, our chances aren't zero...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, if things go well for us...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where does that leave Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you bring up a good point.
Your dream is to keep this park a smile-filled place, right, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Performing elsewhere means spending less time here. Staying with us may mean having to set your dream aside...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll stay here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're saying...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright...!
I'm gonna go ask them myself about you guys freelancing! I'll be like, “Pretty please!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, but that might be tough since Shosuke can be really stubborn...!
Hmm... Wait, what if we bribed him with...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You made your decision clear last time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You don't plan on coming with us.
You wish to protect this place...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, with that in mind... Please allow me to ask you one last time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to join us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, becoming a freelancer means no longer being a member of the Wonder Stage's cast...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thus, you choosing to go with us does mean spending less time at this park...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which may make it difficult for you to fulfill your dream of protecting Phoenix Wonderland and keeping it filled with smiles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's perfectly natural for you to believe that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I see it a different way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe your dream isn't bound to just this place.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember what you said when we talked about our dreams on that desert island?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me next! Me next!
My dream's to make lots and lots of people smile like my grandpa used to say♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You wish to make the masses smile just as your grandfather did.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be really wonderhoy if I could make everyone around the world smile like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's the case... If that's how you feel, you should be able to do the same with us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our collective goal is to make people around the world smile through our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should join us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's make the whole world smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Rui must've thought about this a whole lot...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (About our dream... About my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He wants all our dreams to come true. He wants us all to smile.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm staying.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys are gonna make the entire world smile, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You won't be making your dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If making everyone around the world smile is your dream, you need to do it yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Nene, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to protect this park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When people stopped coming to the Wonder Stage, I felt sad... Really sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it had always been a place that made everyone smile from ear to ear...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to learn how to protect this place on my own.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to make sure this park keeps being a place that makes everyone smile forever and ever.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This place Grandpa loved so much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She seems very adamant...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...
You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad we had a chance to hear how you really feel, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, I...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Don't look so sad, you guys...!
You're all about to take a huge step towards achieving your dreams!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'll be rooting for you all the way!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, good luck!
Make your dreams come true, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What if we tried a different approach...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you said that we should start freelancing, Rui, I honestly felt really happy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If they give us the green light, we'll be able to grow as actors by performing elsewhere with other people...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And it felt like maybe we wouldn't have to go our separate ways like I thought, and we'd get to keep doing shows together...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of us. Including Emu...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Protecting Phoenix Wonderland is Emu's top priority...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even after we start freelancing, we'll still get to do shows there. We'll still get to be with her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it'll mean us slowly drifting apart as we pursue our individual goals...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Things will likely change.
We won't be able to put on shows together as we have been...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Which means...
We won't really be a part of the same troupe. We'll essentially cease being Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping that Emu would accept our offer and come with us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if she's this determined to stay, then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're out of options.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If Emu does not wish to join us, then the three of us will just have to go on without her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, Tsukasa, just like that...?
You're really okay with...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Once upon a time, there was an eccentric traveling theater troupe♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO's narrating...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The troupe consists of a show-offy troupe leader...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A clown who won't listen...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And a songstress who can't sing in public!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. They've swapped roles since last time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The oddball group staged many shows, but they never managed to attract an audience!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then one day, as they were traveling through a forest, they encountered an alchemist who was performing a show all alone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. The troupe's all here...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see how they're gonna do this!)

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I am a showman, and I could use your help to put on wonderful shows!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I promise that our spectacles will be a joy to see and a joy to perform in!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line:
“You wish to make shows with me?
I see. I suppose I could help you out a little.”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Yaaay! Welcome to our troupe!”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “But will I...find the courage to sing?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line:
“Why were you making shows?
Wasn't it because you wanted to make people happy?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The showman remembered the first time he saw a theatrical performance, and regretted the way he treated his troupe members.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “I've always wanted to become a star like the actors in the first show I saw. I wanted to be a star so that I too could make people as happy as I was then.”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “It was very important to me, but I forgot it along the way. I shall never forget it again!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“What I want is to make people smile.
I want to perform with my troupe again!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. This really takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's as if this all happened just yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's about to end...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (With, “And they made shows together forever after”...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They continued merrily making shows together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But one day, they each began to dream of different things.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The troupe leader wished to become an even bigger star.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The songstress wished to sing all around the world.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The alchemist wished to put on a show that would make anybody and everybody smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They changed the ending...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And the clown...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: ...wished to fill the village where she met her dear friends with smiles and happiness.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hang on...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Is this about us...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Each of these dreams was very meaningful to them. Thus, they decided to go their separate ways.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But they also made a promise together.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “One day... One day, when we've all achieved our dreams...”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“Let's meet again here.
To put on another show!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And so, time went on...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It was only a blink of an eye compared to the span of a person's life. But it must've felt like an eternity to these four...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Fortunately, by the time the clown had built an amusement park that made everybody in the village smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They all returned.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “Hey, we're back!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line:
“What?!
Oh, does this mean...?!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“Hm? Why the look of surprise?!
I became a world-famous star just like I said I would! You should be happier!”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line:
“I made my dream come true as well!
My singing can reach people all over the world!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “Hehe. We apologize for appearing so suddenly. Anyway, let's get down to business...”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “What kind of show shall we put on?”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Hehe...!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “There's lots and lots of shows that I wanna do with you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “So, let's do them all...!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our four heroes continued following their various paths in life, but reunited as a troupe that would gather once again at the clown's amusement park from time to time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And they made shows together forever after...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The us in this show were able to do shows together again after saying goodbye.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Which means we might also...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, I'm sure of it. Someday, we'll...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
That was such a wonderhoy ending...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Thank goodness they let me wear this costume...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because if I didn't...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was a super amazing show, you guys! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make our show just as sparkly and fun as the one we saw today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to make our show one that will make everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonder Stage

rows.Line: Alright, we're just about finished cleaning the stage, so let's start heading home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Get home safe, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you not walking with us to the main gate, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Not today!
I just got a message from my brothers... They're coming here to meet me in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Then, we'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The taiyaki place we always go to started selling ones with a strawberry milk flavored filling yesterday. Let's go grab some tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, farewell!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

We had another really fun practice today! Everyone sounded so excited about our show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Probably because of the one Miku and the others put on for us, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was so good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: KAITO and the others did a wonderhoy job as the troupe members.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And they even changed the ending.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They went their separate ways, but all came back together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They won't stop...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm Emu Otori!
Welcome to the fantastic Wonder Stage, a place filled with lots of smiles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's put on some incredible shows together, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...? Wh-Whaaaaaat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the heck is going on?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Say hello to our new stage director!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! You're the performer from yesterday!
Welcome, and wonderhoy☆

rows.Line:
Hmm... I didn't know about this stage.
It's old, but well-maintained.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You must be the other cast member Tsukasa mentioned. I'm Rui Kamishiro. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Little Robot, do you have a name?

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line: A name... Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, we haven't named the robot.
Could you tell them your name instead this time?

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line:
...
Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show Miku and the others put on for us today was extraordinary.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it certainly was.
Their thoughtfulness really knows no bounds.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may be going our separate ways now, but we can still be together again someday... At least, that's the message I heard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel a lot better about what's ahead after seeing their show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you think Emu's gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She had her usual smile during practice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But she's also able to keep smiling for someone else's sake. Even when she's not feeling all that great...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I wish there were something we could do for her...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this time around...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I still wanna do as much stuff as I can with her. Like going home together, messaging each other and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I just remembered that I left my phone in the changing room...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Then, you need to go get it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, we're still not very far from the Wonder Stage. Shall we head back together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
Sorry, you guys. And thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Just gimme a sec.
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Feel free to take your time since you're moving in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did you hear something just now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Hear what...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Hey, that looks like...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is she...crying...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...?!
N-Nene?! What are you doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, your face...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? No, I...!
I wasn't crying! My eyes are just hurting because I didn't get enough sleep...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You big dummy...!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why are you crying all by yourself?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you're gonna cry... Then cry when we're here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't you remember what I said?! What Tsukasa said?! What Rui said?! We want to do everything we can to make sure you keep smiling!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know... Unlike all those other times, our hands are tied for this one...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But if you feel sad, we should be sharing that feeling together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At least let us do that...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...! But...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want us to be smiling when we say goodbye to each other!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want you guys to feel happy about setting out into the world...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want those smiles of yours to fade away...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tsukasa, meaning to govern!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am Tsukasa Tenma, the soaring pegasus born to rule the showbiz world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a future star, and as the troupe leader of Wonderlands×Showtime, I must interject!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wanting to part ways while smiling— I understand that feeling well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've always been surrounded by smiles and laughter.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The audience is an obvious example, but more to the point...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whenever Rui thinks up a new stunt or special effect, whenever Nene sings, whenever you talk about your big dreams, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We always find ourselves smiling and laughing. We all want each other to be happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why... I understand your desire for us to keep smiling to the very end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We don't have to right now, do we...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Us going our separate ways after having so much fun together is painful to say the least.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My heart aches so much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I am allowing us to all do the same!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take this opportunity to cry together...!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You already are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, didn't you hear what I just said! Now is our chance to cry together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why are you making it into some rule...?
I was trying to have a serious conversation...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now it all just feels stupid...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Your face is so messy now, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It looks all funny...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Look who's talking, Emu!
Your face has turned into a balled up tissue!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That makes yours a crumpled up piece of newspaper...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is so strange...
We're all crying, but laughing at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This situation captures us so well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It does...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for asking me to join you that time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the reason I've been able to make such wonderful friends, and pursue my dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Cry*
Emu, are you there...?
No, wait...
Hm? Why?
It looks like they're somewhat preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I regret not doing this a little sooner...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Hey, all of you!
Sorry, but we need to talk!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We were planning to speak with Emu first...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But since you're all together, we'll say it all right here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Say it all...?
What is it?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This is about what matters the most to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As Emu's brothers, we want to respect her wishes.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Regardless of whether or not she decided to stay, we planned to support her choice.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hearing her decision caused us to begin doubting ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We weren't sure if this would be what's best for her. A lot of things started going through our minds, including whether we'd regret this down the road...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And in the end, we don't believe this is what's best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We understand your wish to protect Phoenix Wonderland and keep it filled with smiles.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Obviously, that makes us happy as the operators of this park, and your passion would make you a valuable member of our team.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you're still just a high schooler...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You should be seeing what the outside world has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The time you have now... What you experience during your youth will surely benefit you down the road in terms of both your dream and your life as a whole.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
And of course...
It will help Phoenix Wonderland in the future.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Think about this, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Before we became this park's operators, we traveled to more places than you can imagine.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: In particular, we got ourselves introduced to the world of show business. And not just theatre. We went around learning as much as we could about the film and animation industries.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I wouldn't say that all of what we saw is helping us with our current jobs. However, I can say that it made us who we are now as professionals...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, really.
And can you guess who suggested that we do that...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It was Grandpa.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And once what you've seen here has made you smile, you should take a look at the world around you...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, unlike what you see on stage, it's not all full of smiles and happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But I'm sure what you witness will become the fuel that drives you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: If you truly wish to protect this place... Go out and expand your horizons, and then return.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Until then, we'll keep an eye on Phoenix Wonderland for you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Because your dream has also become our dream.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Thank you for doing your best to not interfere with our business. That was very considerate of you.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, this is also an important time for you. There's no need for you to shape your thoughts based on our needs...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll do everything in our power to make sure this park keeps growing. To make sure Phoenix Wonderland stays filled with smiles.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And if you still genuinely wish to perform here again someday...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
You'll be more than welcome.
We promise to reward you handsomely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. This is what we've decided.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Won't you join us, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a humble actor, I am in no position to make any claims regarding what your brothers just said.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All I have to say is...that I want to keep doing shows with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I mean that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Emu...
Please allow me to ask you again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I truly wish to keep doing shows with this troupe. I mean every word of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If there's a way for you to pursue your dream as we pursue ours, won't you be willing to reconsider our invitation...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right, Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Come with us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't ever want to break the promise I made to Grandpa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...
If there's a way that lets me protect this park and go with you guys...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Go, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll be eagerly awaiting your return.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go with them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go out there and learn as much as I can! And I'm gonna find a way to fill this park with even more smiles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, everyone...
I didn't mean to make you all worry so much about me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What are you saying? There's no need for you to apologize to us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She's right!
“Sorry” isn't what we want to hear right now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me come with you!

rows.Line: Yeah, I'm all set!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: “What you've all done has without question made this village a much happier place compared to before.”

rows.Line: “However, I also believe that we'll have no trouble maintaining the joy you've bestowed upon us.”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “On top of that, I'm sure seeing what the world outside of here has to offer will only be to your benefit.”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “So, all of you should go! Together!”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “And bring that same joy to everyone around the world!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line:
“Okay...!
Thank you!!!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wow, could things have ended on a happier note?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Me too.
Everyone seems overcome with joy.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm glad they went with this version...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too! And they have such big smiles on their faces!>

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “And so...”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “They made shows together while pursuing their dreams forever after.”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “The end!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Grandpa, that was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I didn't know shows could be this much fun! The story was really exciting, and everyone's smiling from ear to ear...!

rows.Speaker: Grandfather
rows.Line:
Hehe. See what I mean?
I'm so glad we could come today.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Hehe. You're smiling too, Grandpa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone has such big smiles on their faces...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The way they're sparkling's so beautiful...)

rows.Line:

Everyone stopped coming to the Wonder Stage.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Remember when the dragon roared?! That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: I know, right?! I wanna see that again! Just one more time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wanna fill this park with even more smiles...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm gonna go out into the world with everyone, learn as much as I can, come back here and put smiles on the faces of all our visitors.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And someday... I'm gonna make everyone around the world smile from ear to ear!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We greatly appreciate you all joining us today, and for all the support you've given us until now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: From the bottom of our hearts, thank you very much!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, that's it. Our final showing's over...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even after they found out we'll be leaving soon, our visitors were willing to give us a nice send-off... That made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I wasn't expecting to receive so many well-wishes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Oh, that reminds me!
Sakurako said, “Make the most of this opportunity like your lives depend on it!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right. She probably had to go back to her own show.
It's amazing how she was there for us right up until the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, our friends from the other stages, including the Phoenix Stage, agreed to put on shows here in our stead. We'll need to thank them again when we get the chance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Your final performance was so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Sis! Keisuke! Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This day wouldn't have been possible without your help. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Still, things aren't going to feel quite the same after you've all left the park...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. Are you sure you're okay?
We know you're a bit of a crybaby.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, do you really need to mention that now?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Now, more importantly...
We have a farewell gift for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A farewell gift?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
Remember what we said about getting ourselves introduced to the world of show business?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: During our travels, we met all sorts of actors and directors. So, I decided to reach out to some of them to see if there are any troupes or companies out there that'd be willing to help you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You did...?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
Three names came up, and they all differ drastically from one another. I'm sure you'll learn a lot from them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You went to all that trouble just for us...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Well, I'm only going to tell you how to get in touch with them. It'll be on you to actually contact them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I need to thank you as well!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It was nothing. There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I mean, I also want to see what happens after you've been given a chance to really grow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now...
Before we leave, I believe it's time for us to make our special salute.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: A special salute?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
We'd like to take this opportunity to say goodbye to our most valued companion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, Tsukasa, take it away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is our final salute... To the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were the reason we were able to have as much fun as we did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for all that you've given us until now!!!
